title: Uniform Stability of the Spherical Laughlin Gap

abstractEnglish: We prove that the fermionic Laughlin V1 Hamiltonian at filling 1/3 on expanding round spheres retains a unique ground state and a uniform spectral gap under sufficiently weak bounded real scalar one-body potentials projected to the lowest Landau level. With coefficient one for each pair projector and Laughlin flux $`q=3(N-1)`$, the gap and perturbation threshold are uniform for all sufficiently large particle numbers and all potential profiles of supremum norm at most one. The result uses the uniform unperturbed Fock-space gap and gives existential constants.
titleEn: Uniform Stability of the Spherical Laughlin Gap
titleZh: 球面Laughlin能隙的一致稳定性

details.overview: 稿件研究扩张球面上填充因子为1/3的费米子Laughlin V1哈密顿量。摘要表示，在投影到最低朗道能级、足够弱的实标量单体势扰动下，该哈密顿量保持唯一基态和一致谱隙；每对投影算符系数为1、Laughlin磁通q=3(N-1)时，谱隙与扰动阈值对所有充分大的粒子数和上确界范数不超过1的势剖面一致。作者声称结果依赖未扰动Fock空间的一致能隙，并给出存在性常数。该工作涉及分数量子霍尔效应的数学分析；摘要未提供证明细节。
keyPoints: 研究对象为球面上填充1/3的费米子Laughlin V1哈密顿量。
作者声称在弱单体势扰动下保持唯一基态与一致谱隙。
谱隙和扰动阈值对充分大粒子数一致，常数为存在性而非显式。
